mode: New sprite atlas from style references; transparent background
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D side-scrolling game sprite atlas, genuinely transparent background.
Primary request: Create ONE finished pixel-art 4-column by 4-row sprite atlas in a square canvas, each cell equally sized with generous transparent gutters. The attached images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: preserve the reference's detailed pixel-art mining cavern style, charcoal lavender rocks, weathered dark timber, ivory-amethyst crystals, warm amber lamps, slightly toxic green contamination. Same pixel scale and dark outlined hand-dithered materials as the reference. NOT geometric placeholder art, not vector icons, no smooth 3D render. Orthographic side view for a Castlevania-like game. No text, no grid lines, no labels, no background, no ground shadow outside objects. All 16 individual items wholly within their own cell, transparent separation; each approximately fills 70-85% cell width/height. Exact order left to right:
ROW 1: (1) wide wooden mine scaffold walkway, flat walkable top at upper quarter, planks, iron bolts and triangular support hanging below; (2) wide rocky mine ledge, flat walkable top and purple-grey cracked rock underside; (3) wide temporary mineralized crystal platform with flat white top edge and hanging jagged purple-white carbonate crystals; (4) horizontal tarnished iron gas pipe with flange couplings, straight segment.
ROW 2: (1) cast iron gas vent mouth, upward-facing industrial nozzle fixed in fractured purple stone, green glow in mouth, NO large plume; (2) sturdy pushable wooden crate with diagonal slats and iron corner brackets, square silhouette; (3) low profile brass-and-iron pressure switch plate, weighted floor mechanism viewed from side; (4) mechanical gas redirect lever on an iron pedestal, handle angled left, orange-red grip.
ROW 3: (1) large old mine gas pump machinery with pressure gauges and tanks, pipes and battered wood frame; (2) wooden mine hoist and iron pulley winch, side view, fully inside cell; (3) hanging antique amber mine lantern with chain, glass housing and warm lit core; (4) arched mine exit gate made of heavy timber and lavender stone, open dark doorway with pale light inside.
ROW 4: (1) cluster of luminous amethyst and ivory crystals on a dark rock base; (2) cluster of dark jagged hanging stalactites and roots, top-attached; (3) horizontal green acid surface strip, detailed luminous liquid ripples and foamy pale green edge, rectangle strip with no vessel; (4) soft wispy toxic green vapor puff sprite, organic irregular silhouette with mottled pixel clusters and translucent edges.
Keep platforms' top edges horizontal and clearly visible. Keep strong silhouettes and rich material detail. The layout must be strictly 4 x 4, with no item bridging between cells. True alpha transparency, not checkerboard painted as background.
